test_EmbeddingEncoder_sum_pooling: test EmbeddingEncoder with sum pooling to aggregate embeddings by summing across the sequence dimension
test_EmbeddingEncoder_mean_pooling: test EmbeddingEncoder with mean pooling to compute the average of embeddings in a batch
test_EmbeddingEncoder_max_pooling: test EmbeddingEncoder with max pooling to select the maximum embedding values per sequence
test_EmbeddingEncoder_hash: test EmbeddingEncoder with hashing enabled to handle out-of-vocabulary indices via modulo hashing
test_EmbeddingEncoder_invalid_pooling: test EmbeddingEncoder raises ValueError when an invalid pooling type is provided
